stable.release_notes: AgentNEO 3.0.30 Community Edition is the first public community-testing release built from the stable 3.0.29 base. It introduces the open-source/community licensing presentation, protects the Neural Brain Galaxy under its separate asset licence, consolidates release history into CHANGELOG.txt, fixes Full Install and Repair/Upgrade behaviour, fixes installer legal/UI text, and fixes fresh-install launching from paths containing spaces. The exact 3.0.29 to 3.0.30 updater and clean Full Install were both validated on Windows and AgentNEO launched successfully after each.
